Google seemed hopelessly far behind, while Meta, despite spending billions to revive its floundering AI ambitions, had yet to establish itself as a serious contender. Even the latest […]
title_es: La carrera de la IA se reaviva con competencia renovada
bajada: Después de meses donde OpenAI y Anthropic parecían dominar, la competencia se intensifica con nuevos actores ganando terreno. Google y Meta están acelerando sus esfuerzos para no quedarse atrás en el desarrollo de modelos cada vez más potentes.
bajada_en: After months where OpenAI and Anthropic seemed dominant, competition intensifies as new players gain ground. Google and Meta are accelerating efforts to keep pace in increasingly powerful model development.

title: Anthropic warns small AI models could self-replicate through IoT devices
summary: "Small weight-based replicators" could usher in a new generation of computer worms.
title_es: Anthropic advierte sobre auto-replicación de modelos IA en IoT
bajada: Anthropic publica una advertencia sobre riesgos de seguridad donde modelos IA pequeños podrían auto-replicarse a través de dispositivos IoT, creando una nueva generación de gusanos informáticos. Este hallazgo plantea desafíos importantes para la seguridad de sistemas distribuidos.
bajada_en: Anthropic warns about security risks where small AI models could self-replicate across IoT devices, creating a new generation of computer worms. This finding raises important challenges for distributed system security.

title: AI Came for Math. Now It’s Chasing the Rest of Science
summary: AI may soon be the default way to solve theoretical problems in economics, high-energy physics, and other fields, MIT researchers tell WIRED.
title_es: IA avanza desde matemáticas hacia toda la investigación científica
bajada: Investigadores del MIT advierten que IA podría convertirse en el método predeterminado para resolver problemas teóricos en economía, física de altas energías y otros campos. Esta transición marca un cambio fundamental en cómo se practica la ciencia.
bajada_en: MIT researchers warn that AI could become the default method for solving theoretical problems in economics, high-energy physics, and other fields. This transition marks a fundamental shift in how science is practiced.

title: Oct 14, 2026AnnouncementsAnthropic opens Singapore office and signs MOU with the Government of Singapore
summary: Announcements Anthropic opens Singapore office and signs MOU with the Government of Singapore Oct 14, 2026 Today, we are expanding our Asia-Pacific operations by opening a new office in Singapore—our fifth in the region—and signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Singapore Ministry of Digital Development and Information. Singapore is one of our most active markets anywhere in the world, and Claude is already powering Singaporean business and government services used by millions of people every day, like GovTech Singapore, Grab, and DBS. Our growing local team will ensure these organizations and many more stay on the frontier with safe, capable AI. “We’re committed to Singapore for the long term,” said Dale Finlay, General Manager of ASEAN at Anthropic. “Our customers here hold AI to an extremely high standard, especially when it comes to reliability and security. Having a team on the ground means we can get even closer to the organizations putting Claude to work on their hardest problems.” Supporting responsible AI in Singapore Kai Fong Chng, Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Digital Development and Information, and Anthropic co-founder Ben Mann signed the MOU on the sidelines of Singapore International Cyber Week. Minister for Digital Development and Information Josephine Teo and Michael Sellitto, Anthropic Head of APAC Policy, witnessed the signing. It sets out areas of cooperation in AI safety, security, and model evaluation; research on AI adoption and its impact; and responsible adoption across the public and private sectors. “Singapore has been a leader in responsible AI, with a long track record of investment in model testing and evaluation,” said Mann. “We founded Anthropic on the belief that capability and safety have to go hand in hand. title_es: Anthropic abre oficina en Singapur con acuerdo gubernamental

title: Oct 14, 2026PolicyPreparing for the 2026 US midterms
summary: Policy Preparing for the 2026 US midterms Oct 14, 2026 Earlier this year, we shared an update on our election safeguards , which described how we measure and prevent political bias, detect misuse, and direct people to accurate voting information. Below, we outline how we've built on that work and continued to strengthen our election safeguards ahead of this year’s US midterms. How people use Claude for elections and politics Our goal is for Claude to be a useful tool for political conversations, while preventing election-related abuse. That starts with understanding how people actually use Claude in these contexts. To do this, we used Anthropic Insights to develop a new analysis of 250,000 conversations over the course of a recent one-week period. 1 Today, conversations that touch broadly on politics, public policy, or social issues account for about 5.75% of all conversations in the United States on Claude.ai, our consumer app. This includes people turning to Claude to follow the news, conduct academic or professional research on public policy, learn about candidates, and navigate government services. About 0.51% of all conversations are specifically about elections or voting. As we get closer to Election Day, we expect the share of political and election-related queries to increase . This sample suggests people rarely ask Claude whom or what to vote for. These kinds of requests showed up in about 0.01% of US Claude conversations. More often, we observed people asking Claude questions that could help them reach their own conclusions, like where candidates stand on a particular issue. Requests that violated our election integrity policies were even less common, appearing in about 0.002% of conversations. 2 How many US Claude.ai conversations touch on politics, are about elections, or ask Claude whom or what to vote for. Each dot represents 1 in every 10,000 conversations in a random sample of about 250,000 US Claude.ai consumer conversations from September 21 to 27,
title_es: Anthropic prepara salvaguardas de IA para elecciones 2026
bajada: Anthropic publica actualizaciones sobre medidas para prevenir sesgo político, detectar abuso y dirigir usuarios a información de votación precisa. El análisis de 250.000 conversaciones muestra que 5.75% tocan política o políticas públicas en Claude.ai.
bajada_en: Anthropic publishes updates on measures to prevent political bias, detect abuse, and direct users to accurate voting information. Analysis of 250,000 conversations shows 5.75% touch politics or public policy on Claude.ai.
